scope: Read-only audit of combined snapshot and current effective training configuration; no code mutation or NPU execution.

global_off_vs_action_only.active_modules: Action expert36 Qwen2DecoderLayer modules, two calls per layer: QKV and output-projection+MoE.
unchanged_subnets: Frozen Qwen3-VL vision/text components are kept eval by QwenvlWithExpertV2Model.train(), disabling their GradientCheckpointingLayer wrappers already.

Trainable current/future depth and video heads are TaskTokenDepthHead -> TaskTokenResampler with ordinary nn.Module, Linear, LayerNorm and attention; no gradient_checkpointing attribute or explicit checkpoint call.
State/action/time projections and trainable task embeddings do not use checkpoint.
Depth/video teachers are independent local variables built outside the main model and do not receive model.gradient_checkpointing_enable().
Joint attention between the two decoder-layer calls is outside checkpoint regions.
global_off_vs_action_only.other_global_branch: enable_gradient_checkpointing also reaches activation offloading setup, but enable_activation_offload=false means both choices return nullcontext.
conditions: enable_expert_vision=false (default in the selected model config)
global_off_vs_action_only.limit: This is source/config equivalence for the current model graph, not a promise for future unfrozen VLM or offloading configurations. Verify final combined_no_checkpoint YAML actually records false.

moe_training_semantics.counter_update: _update_moe_runtime_stats adds to tokens_per_expert on every training-mode MoE forward, including recomputation.
moe_training_semantics.checkpoint_effect: Current non-reentrant output+MoE checkpoint ordinarily calls MoE twice per update; existing profile recorded72 calls/update for36 layers. With checkpoint off there is one call per layer.
moe_training_semantics.sequence_balance_loss: Computed from original router_logits_list by triton_sequence_wise_balance_loss; its local top-k counts are separate from module tokens_per_expert. It does not read the mutable monitoring counter.
moe_training_semantics.router_z_loss: Computed from original router logits, independent of counter.
moe_training_semantics.correction_bias_effect: Optimizer hook still all-reduces counts, snapshots last_tokens_per_expert and clears accumulated counts. Zero coeff and no centering leave correction bias unchanged.
moe_training_semantics.math_conclusion: Counter multiplicity does not alter the training objective or correction-bias update under this configuration; actual gradients can still differ from backend/recomputation numerical order.

monitoring_semantics.timing: Forward monitoring reads clones of last_tokens_per_expert from the preceding optimizer step, so counts lag one update; first update has empty snapshots and skips count metrics.
monitoring_semantics.count_unit: Expert assignments, not unique tokens: top_k4 means each of the96*51 tokens contributes4 assignments.
scale_invariant_if_routing_matches: global load_cv when every layer changes by the same factor
unaffected_by_counter_scale: entropy from original router probability distributions
monitoring_semantics.normalization_caveat: Uniform factor-two invariance assumes recomputation routes identically. Recomputed floating-point differences near top-k ties can change distributions; mixed per-layer policies also change relative weighting of the global histogram.

future_correction_candidate.desired_semantics: Count logical forward assignments once, independent of checkpoint policy; mark recompute context and suppress runtime-stat accumulation there, then test forward/backward and all metrics.
future_correction_candidate.avoid: Do not blindly divide all counts by2: it fails for no-checkpoint, selective policies, altered recompute early-stop behavior or differing update windows.
future_correction_candidate.require_validation: Check per-layer totals, zero-count startup, gradient accumulation, update_interval>1 and resume; verify unchanged loss and gradients for fixed batches.
